tools.name: orkid_quote
tools.description: Get a live, non-executing swap quote from the Orkid solver network (gasless via Permit2, MEV-protected). Same-chain swaps on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Unichain, BSC, Robinhood. The response includes a swapUrl — send the user there to sign; the agent never touches keys. Free with X-ORKID-API-Key head

tools.name: orkid_swap_link
tools.description: Build a hydrated Orkid swap URL (prefilled pair, amount, chain, partner attribution). Send this link to the user — they review and sign in their own wallet. Requires X-ORKID-API-Key header like all tool calls.

tools.name: orkid_chains
tools.description: List chains where Orkid same-chain swaps are live, bridge coverage, and gasless minimums.

tools.name: orkid_bridge_quote
tools.description: Get a non-custodial cross-chain bridge quote (Across) between Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, and Robinhood (4663). Returns unsigned transaction data — the depositor wallet signs and broadcasts. Free with X-ORKID-API-Key header or $0.002 USDC/call via x402.
